nodes.label: VOLTAGE — festival template
nodes.rationale: Grafisch-tier event template (black x acid yellow x purple, Anton). Archetype J poster/diagonal: tilted giant hero title with purple text-shadow over a diagonal acid slash band, line-up as rotated poster billing wall, marquee, day-tabbed timetable, three tilted ticket-tier cards, info dl and signup form. Rotations neutralized under prefers-reduced-motion.

nodes.label: Day-tabs ARIA tablist for the festival timetable
nodes.rationale: WAI-ARIA tabs pattern for the two festival days: aria-selected + roving tabindex, ArrowLeft/Right with wrap, Home/End, panels toggled via hidden and an .on class. Click activates without stealing focus; keyboard activation moves focus.
